Ram Mandir Trust Appoints New CEO Amidst Controversy

Air Marshal Jitendra Mishra has been appointed as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, which manages the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. Mishra was selected from a pool of 5,586 applicants. His appointment has drawn attention from some media outlets, with questions raised about the selection process and potential media restrictions. One outlet suggested his appointment was anticipated due to a connection with the Prime Minister's Office, while another highlighted the large number of applicants he surpassed.
